usage: 堂弟 is a noun used to refer to a younger male cousin on your father's side.
You use 堂弟 when talking about family relations specifically from your paternal side.
It usually contrasts with 表弟 (younger male cousin from the mother's side).
堂弟 can be used in both formal and informal conversations about family.
When speaking, you can add possessive markers like 我嘅堂弟 (my younger male cousin, paternal).
